name: Jellyfin
description: Media server for streaming your own movies, series and music to any device.

ru.description: Медиасервер для стриминга своих фильмов, сериалов и музыки на любые устройства.

meta.about: Media server for audio, video, books, comics, and photos with a sleek interface and robust transcoding capabilities. Almost all modern platforms have clients, including Roku, Android TV, iOS, and Kodi.
